title: Predicting local control of brain metastases after stereotactic radiotherapy with clinical, radiomics and deep learning features.
summary: retrospective stereotactic radiotherapy brain-metastasis cohort (129 patients); radiomic and deep-learning MRI features plus clinical covariates fed prediction models for local failure/control. Clinical+DL model accuracy 78%; clinical+radiomics 79.33%; models evaluated on held-out data. Clinical prediction result only; limited cohort and retrospective design, not treatment benefit. Methods/Results: retrospective stereotactic radiotherapy brain-metastasis cohort (129 patients); radiomic and deep-learning MRI features plus clinical covariates fed prediction models for local failure/control. Testing: Methods/Results: retrospective stereotactic radiotherapy brain-metastasis cohort (129 patients); radiomic and deep-learning MRI features plus clinical covariates fed prediction models for local failure/control. Clinical prediction result only; limited cohort and retrospective design, not treatment benefit.. ML feature models predict a concrete clinical outcome in a defined treated population and were assessed against observed local control; eligible retrospective diagnostic/prognostic validation under methodology.html, with single-center/sample limitations.
